Every mission is rehearsed on Earth first.

Teams need to know which parts match, where, and when.

One Earth site vs. Shackleton crater 48.3°N 114.1°E

No single score. Every trait keeps its own verdict.

Every place on Earth, trait by trait.

Enter the test and the location, and receive the information to pick the right location on Earth.

Earth data: Copernicus DEM · NASA MODIS · MERRA-2 · ESA CCI Permafrost · travel time (Weiss et al. 2018) · OurAirports · NASA EONET

Pick a world.

Start with the Moon or Mars. Gravity and air are shown up front, because Earth can match neither.

  1. 1Moon: polar terrain, low sun, cold traps, sharp regolith.
  2. 2Mars: 0.38 g and thin CO₂ air, before you begin.
